<!-- 简要说明本 PR 做了什么 -->

## 关联 Issue / Related issues
<!-- 例：Closes #12 -->

## 变更类型 / Type of change
- [ ] feat 新功能 / new feature
- [ ] fix 修复 / bug fix
- [ ] docs 文档 / documentation
- [ ] refactor 重构 / refactor
- [ ] perf 性能 / performance
- [ ] build/ci 构建或 CI
- [ ] chore 其它 / chore

## 自查清单 / Checklist
- [ ] 已在真机/模拟器上验证 / Tested on a real device or emulator
- [ ] 遵循 Conventional Commits 提交规范 / Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] 如涉及 UI，已附截图 / Screenshots attached for UI changes
- [ ] 已更新 CHANGELOG（如需要）/ CHANGELOG updated if needed
- [ ] 不包含任何密钥/keystore / No secrets or keystores included
